identity.name: asyra-agent
identity.description: Build and extend products with Asyra using its public APIs, ownership patterns and formal verification. Includes versioned reference guides.

codexInterface.longDescription: Build and extend Asyra products from your requirements. Includes the maintained Starter architecture and offline guides for Features, canonical state, UI subscriptions, transactions, persistence and verification. Works in Codex with your existing model and project permissions. This skills-only plugin provides development guidance; it does not host an AI service, upgrade project dependencies, or guarantee generated code is correct. Review and test your product before use.
defaultPrompt: Build a personal expense tracker with Asyra, including precise totals, Undo/Redo and browser storage.
Add tags and combined filters to my existing Asyra app while preserving saved data and history.
